text: Yes, the property lost tree cover in 2019. Earth-observation data shows that 1.8 hectares of planted pine forest (*Pinus elliottii y Pinus taeda*) were cleared, representing about 0.05% of the total asset area. This loss was corroborated by the European Commission’s 2020 forest reference dataset, which confirmed the area was forested before the event. While there were additional small patches of loss (3.1 ha) below the minimum reporting threshold, the 1.8-hectare clearing was the primary event detected.
